title: Add SHADOW market-regime engine with defensive-asset comparison
current: StockTracker scores individual symbols and uses VIX/context, but it does not classify the broad market into risk-on, neutral, or risk-off regimes or compare equity signals with a defensive T-bill proxy.
proposed: Add a SHADOW-only regime engine using SPY 50/200-day trend, SPY 20-day momentum, QQQ 200-day confirmation, and VIX. Log RISK_ON/NEUTRAL/RISK_OFF state plus the counterfactual action for equity BUY candidates. Use SGOV only as a simulated defensive benchmark in RISK_OFF. Do not block, resize, or submit any different orders.
evidence: User requested evaluation of a methodology that favors stocks in favorable markets and T-bills when market conditions deteriorate.
StockTracker already consumes SPY, QQQ, and VIX, so a regime layer can be measured without changing the existing symbol-scoring model.
The newly deployed decision-funnel telemetry provides the event IDs needed to compare regime-filtered counterfactuals with the existing paper strategy.
risk: Low execution risk because the regime engine is SHADOW-only. Main risks are extra market-data requests and premature conclusions from small samples; daily-trend data is cached and no live/paper order logic is changed.
status_note: User explicitly authorized this SHADOW market-regime proposal in ChatGPT with 'go'.
